plugins.name: celld
plugins.description: Working with celld — Deno's self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects daemon: writing and deploying Cloudflare Workers apps to a celld fleet, the celld CLI, fleet operations, and celld's durability guarantees.

plugins.name: drizzle-orm
plugins.description: Working with Drizzle ORM and Drizzle Kit — TypeScript schema declaration, the SQL-like and relational query APIs, migrations (generate/migrate/push/pull), driver setup, serverless performance, and the type/mapping pitfalls that bite in production.

plugins.name: planetscale-postgres-serverless
plugins.description: Connecting to PlanetScale Postgres from serverless/edge runtimes with the Neon serverless driver (@neondatabase/serverless) — HTTP vs WebSocket mode, the required neonConfig (fetchEndpoint, wsProxy, pipelineConnect), connection strings, framework setup, ORM integration, and when to use pg + PSBouncer instead.
